mode.description: The operation mode: 'info' for general token info, 'slotlist' for list of slots, 'dump' for dumping objects.

module_path.description: Absolute path to the PKCS#11 provider shared library file.

slot_number.description: The numeric index of the slot to operate on (used when mode is 'dump').

user_pin.description: The user PIN for the token. Use '-' if no PIN is required or if using SO PIN.
